# PHOIBLE parser fixture

These rows are excerpted and minimally reduced from `phoible/dev`'s
`data/phoible.csv` and mapping tables (PHOIBLE data, CC BY-SA 3.0; see
<https://github.com/phoible/dev>). Inventory IDs, source labels, Glottocode,
and BibTeX keys are retained. The two English inventories intentionally pin
PHOIBLE's doculect-spread semantics; `k͈` pins a positioned parser refusal.
